# CineRename - full reference for AI assistants

> CineRename is a local-first media renamer and library organizer that automatically renames and organizes movies, TV shows (series), anime and subtitles for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Kodi libraries. Built in Rust as a fast, modern alternative to FileBot and tinyMediaManager, it previews every change before touching a file, keeps a one-click undo history, and runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, NAS and Docker. Free tier included, with Pro licenses at €1 per month (1 EUR), €5 per year or €30 for a lifetime license.

Website: https://cinerename.app · Latest version: 0.5.7 · Summary index: https://cinerename.app/llms.txt

## At a glance

- **Category:** Media file renamer and library organizer (FileBot alternative)
- **Platforms:** Windows 10/11, macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon), Linux (AppImage, .deb, .rpm, Snap), NAS and Docker (headless CLI)
- **Metadata sources:** TheTVDB, TVmaze, AniList, Kitsu
- **Subtitles:** OpenSubtitles (file fingerprint first, then metadata)
- **Media servers:** Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, Kodi
- **Privacy:** Local-first: your video files are never uploaded
- **Pricing:** Free tier (2 renames and 2 subtitle searches per day). Pro: €1/month, €5/year or €30 lifetime. 14-day money-back guarantee
- **App languages:** English, French, Spanish, Simplified Chinese
- **Latest version:** 0.5.7

## Pricing

CineRename offers a limited free tier. You can rename up to 2 files per day and run up to 2 subtitle searches per day. Full and unlimited features are included in the Pro license.

- **Free:** €0 — Rename (2 files/day); Subtitle searches (2/day); Before/after preview. All other features require the Pro version.
- **Monthly:** €1 /month — Multi-seat license (up to 20 concurrent devices); Unlimited processing of movies, TV shows and anime; Automatic subtitles download; Smart duplicate cleaning; 100% Autonomous mode; Command Line Interface (CLI); 100% unlocked app (all features included).
- **Annual:** €5 /year — Multi-seat license (up to 20 concurrent devices); Unlimited processing of movies, TV shows and anime; Automatic subtitles download; Smart duplicate cleaning; 100% Autonomous mode; Command Line Interface (CLI); 100% unlocked app (all features included).
- **Pro lifetime:** €30 lifetime — Multi-seat license (up to 20 concurrent devices); 100% unlocked app (all features included); All future updates included; Priority support channel.

Taxes included. The displayed price is the price you pay, with no extra tax added at checkout. Money-back guarantee: 14 days, full refund. Instant delivery: you will receive your license key by email immediately after purchase to unlock the application.
Pricing page: https://cinerename.app/pricing

## Frequently asked questions

### How does it compare to FileBot or TinyMediaManager?

CineRename was built from the ground up in Rust to be lightning-fast. Unlike older Java-based tools, it can process thousands of files without UI lag. We also built features that are usually missing: native ZIP/RAR extraction, an interactive visual preview, a full 'Undo' history, and multi-quality duplicate hunting.

### Does it support Anime (Absolute numbering)?

Yes. CineRename supports anime presets with absolute episode numbering or season/episode output, plus OVA and Specials handling. For long shows where platforms disagree on seasons, you can keep absolute numbering and still fetch localized episode titles when available.

### Do I have to pay a monthly subscription?

No. While we offer a yearly license for updates, we also provide a one-time 'Lifetime' payment option. We hate subscription fatigue as much as you do.

### Will my files be uploaded to the cloud?

No. CineRename processes your files locally. Network requests only go to configured metadata and subtitle providers, and they contain titles, IDs, language choices, or the OpenSubtitles file fingerprint — never the video file itself.

### Can it help find subtitles matching my release?

CineRename gives you the best possible match without promising magic. It uses the OpenSubtitles file fingerprint first, then falls back to title and metadata IDs. You can preview the subtitle before downloading it, and timing tools are available if a release still needs an offset or drift adjustment.

### Why use CineRename instead of Sonarr/Radarr?

Sonarr and Radarr are powerful for full automation, but they require significant setup with indexers and download clients. CineRename is a lightweight, standalone tool for cleaning an existing messy drive or quickly organizing files without running a 24/7 server.

### Does it run on my Headless NAS (Synology, Unraid)?

Yes. CineRename has a lightweight headless CLI, WebUI/TUI modes and Docker packaging. On servers, use the scheduler, cron, or download-client hooks; desktop Watch Folders remain available in the GUI app.

### What happens if I make a mistake and rename thousands of files poorly?

Don't panic! CineRename tracks every operation in its History module. With a single click, you can undo a massive batch rename, and all your files will be restored to their original names and locations.

### How will I receive my Pro license?

After purchase, you will immediately receive a license key by email. Simply enter it into the application to unlock the Pro version.

### Is CineRename legal to use?

Yes. CineRename is a neutral file management tool. We do not host, provide, sell, or distribute movies, TV shows, anime, or other copyrighted media. The software only helps users organize files they already have the legal right to use.

## Comparisons with other tools

- [Best FileBot Alternative 2026: CineRename vs FileBot](https://cinerename.app/vs-filebot): Why CineRename is the #1 modern alternative to FileBot in 2026: visual UI, TMDB/TVDB matching, automatic subtitles, duplicate cleaner, no Java required.
- [CineRename vs tinyMediaManager — Best TMM Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-tinymediamanager): Why CineRename is the best tinyMediaManager alternative: fast native Rust app, no mandatory yearly subscription, live visual preview and 1-click undo.
- [CineRename vs Sonarr — Best Sonarr Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-sonarr): Why choose CineRename over Sonarr? A visual desktop app for movies, TV series and anime — no server, no Docker, no port configuration required.
- [CineRename vs Radarr — Best Radarr Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-radarr): CineRename vs Radarr: instant drag-and-drop, visual preview with posters, TV series and anime support alongside movies, and 1-click undo.
- [CineRename vs Rename My TV Series — Comparison](https://cinerename.app/vs-rename-my-tv-series): Rename My TV Series (Name My TV Series) only handles TV shows. CineRename renames movies, series and anime, with subtitles and duplicate detection.
- [CineRename vs TV Rename — Best TVRename Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-tv-rename): TV Rename is Windows-only and limited to TV shows. CineRename runs natively on macOS, Windows, and Linux, supports movies and anime, and downloads subtitles.
- [CineRename vs Advanced Renamer — Best Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-advanced-renamer): Advanced Renamer has no media awareness. CineRename recognizes movies and TV shows via TheTVDB, TVmaze and AniList, with posters and subtitles.
- [CineRename vs Bulk Rename Utility — Best Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-bulk-rename-utility): Bulk Rename Utility has a dated UI and no media recognition. CineRename offers a modern visual studio with posters, metadata and 1-click undo.
- [CineRename vs MediaElch — Best MediaElch Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-mediaelch): MediaElch is focused on Kodi NFO scraping. CineRename is built for fast batch renaming, synced subtitles, duplicate cleanup and Plex/Jellyfin.
- [CineRename vs Shoko Anime — Best Shoko Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-shoko-anime): Shoko (Shoko Anime, formerly JMM) needs a local server and only handles anime. CineRename manages anime, TV series and movies in one lightweight app.
- [CineRename vs Movie Renamer — Best Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-movie-renamer): Movie Renamer (incl. Movie Renamer Ultimate) only handles movies. CineRename organizes movies, series and anime, with subtitles and duplicate cleanup.
- [CineRename vs theRenamer — Best theRenamer Alternative](https://cinerename.app/vs-therenamer): theRenamer has been abandoned for over a decade. Switch to CineRename: native Rust app, current APIs (TVDB v4, TVmaze), subtitles and 4K HDR support.
